verdict.rationale: Missive documents search filters for Type (Internal/External) and Date range, and command-bar search across all messages, contacts, or a specific label. That is real first-party search capability, but there is no evidence of query operators, result ranking, speed, or coverage of full mail history. Missing for 10: documented search operators/syntax, ranked or relevance-sorted results, evidence of search speed, confirmation that search spans full history, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
